recipe.horsegenetics.basic_ticket.desc: Right-click your horse to send it to its stall. One use, overworld only.
recipe.horsegenetics.basic_whistle.desc: Right-click to call every tamed horse you own nearby. The shortest range of the three.
recipe.horsegenetics.blank_ticket.desc: The unwritten ticket the other three are made from.
recipe.horsegenetics.blank_transfer_pape: Sign it against a horse you own and whoever holds the paper can claim that horse.
recipe.horsegenetics.bound_ticket.desc: Sends your horse to its stall from any world - so long as the stall is in that same world.
recipe.horsegenetics.braided_rope.desc: Rope braided from horse hair - a building block for the heavier items.
recipe.horsegenetics.braided_rope_to_bun: Unpicks a braided rope back into the hair bundles it was made from.
recipe.horsegenetics.cowboy_hitch.desc: A post that turns an unemployed villager nearby into a cowboy.
recipe.horsegenetics.dilution_gene_splic: Aims a splice at the loci that change what colour the pigment is - cream, pearl, champagne, dun, flaxen, mushroom, grey, tiger eye.
recipe.horsegenetics.echo_whistle.desc: The longest-reaching area whistle. Calls your tamed horses from further than either other tier.
recipe.horsegenetics.empty_seed_jar.desc: Fill it from a stallion to breed a mare with him later, from anywhere, without him being there.
recipe.horsegenetics.ender_whistle.desc: Right-click one of your horses to bind it for good. Then it calls that one horse from anywhere - even another dimension. It turns to dust if the horse dies.
recipe.horsegenetics.equestrian_bench.de: Dyes a saddle's seat, its bridle and its metal fittings separately - one dye or one ingot per part, so a saddle is coloured a piece at a time. Iron puts the fittings back to plain steel.
recipe.horsegenetics.equine_research_she: Files research papers - one of each gene - and copies any of them onto a blank book for as long as the original stays in it. Breaking it gives every paper back.
recipe.horsegenetics.golden_whistle.desc: The middle whistle - calls your tamed horses from further off than the basic one.
recipe.horsegenetics.hair_cloth.desc: Cloth woven from horse hair, for the items rope alone will not make.
recipe.horsegenetics.hair_cloth_to_bundl: Unpicks hair cloth back into the hair bundles it was made from.
recipe.horsegenetics.holding_pen_sign.de: Hang it on a pen's wall to make that pen yours: holding pen tickets send your horses there. One pen per player.
Right-click any horse you own - just tamed, no stall yet - to send it to your holding pen. One use, from any world.
recipe.horsegenetics.horse_hair_bundle.d: Nine hairs bundled for storage. Horse hair is the base material for almost everything the mod adds.
recipe.horsegenetics.horse_hair_from_bun: Unpacks a bundle back into the nine hairs that went into it.
recipe.horsegenetics.interdimensional_ti: Sends your horse to its stall from anywhere, across worlds. The only ticket that crosses.
recipe.horsegenetics.magical_gene_splice: Aims a splice at everything the mod counts as magical, whatever it does.
recipe.horsegenetics.magnifier_carrot.de: The mirror of the stabilizer - the parent passes on its recessive copy instead. Does nothing where it has none.
recipe.horsegenetics.marking_gene_splice: Aims a splice at patterned or shaded pigment that is neither white nor a dilution - sooty, pangare, primitive striping, rabicano, brindle.
recipe.horsegenetics.performance_gene_sp: Aims a splice at the natural loci that move speed, health or jump - and only upward.
recipe.horsegenetics.stabilizer_carrot.d: Feed a parent: at every heterozygous locus it passes on the dominant copy rather than a coin flip. Does nothing where the parent has no dominant allele.
recipe.horsegenetics.stall_sign.desc: Bind it to one horse and hang it on a wall to mark the room behind as that horse's stall.
recipe.horsegenetics.unknown_epigenetic_: Re-rolls the epigenetics of every allele this parent passes on. The foal's genotype is untouched - only its bay points, dapples and splash edges change.
recipe.horsegenetics.unknown_gene_splice: Rolls one random gene and redraws this parent's contribution to it. Never the sex locus, and never anything that would hurt the foal.
recipe.horsegenetics.vet_kit.desc: Sneak-use on your stallion or colt to geld him. Use it plainly on any horse to examine it: a mare's heat, a pregnancy and whether it is twins, a stallion's covers today.
recipe.horsegenetics.white_gene_splice_c: Aims a splice at the loci that take pigment away in patches - KIT, tobiano, the splashes and the leopard complex.
tooltip.horsegenetics.transfer_paper.hin: Right-click a horse you own to sign it over
tooltip.horsegenetics.transfer_paper.red: Right-click this horse to claim it
tooltip.horsegenetics.transfer_paper.unb: Unbound - remake it at a bench
